PERSONAL_DETAILS: Chabwino, kwakhala pang`ono kumaliza. Tifuna kuti tikufunseni mafunso ang`ono pa inu. Ichi chitithandiza kupereka nkhani yanu ku anthu oyengera.
DONT_REUSE_DETAILS: Ok, kodi mungafune kuyanhka mafunso aya ka cibili?
GREETINGS: 👋 Bwanji! Izi ndi zapamakina zofotokozelanapo ndemanga pa zomwe mwapitamo ndi mabungwe a mdela lanu.
PROMOTE_DESCRIPTION: Cabwino. TalkToLoop.org ndiye mphala yanu yofotokoza ndi kuthilapo ndemanga pa nkhani zofunikila kwa inu. Mungati kufuna kudziwa zambiri za Loop pa website yathu www.talktoloop.org
END_OF_SERVICE: Uku ndiye kumapeto kwa nchito iyi ya pamakina.Mungatifotokozele uthenga wina nthawi iliyonse podiniza batani ili m'munsi.
THANKS:
Zikomo pogwilitsa nchito TalkToLoop.org kuti mulankhulepo zakukhosi kwanu ndi kuthandiza kubweletsa sintho yabwino. Tsopano tizaonapo bwino ndi kusindikiza nkhani yanu pakati pa maola 24-48,nthawi zambiri zicitika mwa msanga. Tizakutumuzilani mayankho ngati tayalandila.

Tsalani bwino.

Kuti muyambenso, lembani 'Loop' Kapena dinizani kabatani kali mmunsi nthawi iliyonse 😃.
ADDITIONAL_INFO:
Kodi pali zina zake zomwe mungafotokoze kuti zitithandize kupeleka nkhani ku anthu oyenela? 
Ngati zilipo, yankhani uthenga uyu ndi 🏛️ dzina la (ma)bungwe ndi malo komwe apezeka 🌏️ kapena zili zonse zomwe mungafune kuikako.
Ngati mwamalitsiliza, dinizani kabatani kali m'munsi. u're finished, just tap the button below.
